entries.46a5530616ba9ac9: It is a business that sells mainly through online shops, offering products such as frozen hamburger steaks, frozen Ikinari! Garlic Rice, Ikinari! Steak Set and dressings. It also sells ingredients to businesses on a wholesale basis, including tonkatsu sauce, steak sauce, Ikinari! Garlic Rice and dressings. In addition, under a license agreement with SBIC Co., Ltd., it receives royalty income from sales of products under the delivery-only brand “Ikinari! Yakiniku,” which it operates in ghost restaurants, and from sales of products “supervised by Ikinari! Steak.” Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥53 million.

entries.708acbbee67f6ce7: It is a business that operates, through company-operated and franchised stores, the order-cut steak restaurant “Sumiyaki Steak Kuni,” where steak is cut to the customer’s preferred portions in front of them; the tonkatsu specialty restaurant “Kodawari Tonkatsu Katsukitei”; the sukiyaki specialty restaurant “Sukihana,” which uses only Japanese Wagyu and domestic beef; and the seafood izakaya “Kairi.” The know-how and menus accumulated in this business are also used in the Ikinari! Steak Business. As of December 31, 2025, there were 9 stores, and revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥648 million.

entries.8d3014baf7de9914: It is the company’s core business. Through its proprietary store operation system using electromagnetic cookers with heat-sensitive sensors, it operates “Ikinari! Steak,” which quickly serves heat-cooked dishes such as steak, generally regarded as high-end cuisine, at affordable prices, through company-operated stores, franchises and consignment stores. It also offers the “Niku Mileage” program, which provides benefits according to the number of visits, as well as takeout and delivery services. As of December 31, 2025, there were 183 stores (130 company-operated, 48 franchised and 5 consignment), and revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥13,832 million.
